text_block_list.text: —New Year's Day.
At Curren Bouquetd'or's suggestion, we came to watch the first sunrise of the year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The east is this way, right?
—I wonder if we'll get a nice view.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
It really is getting a bit chilly, isn't it?

Hearing those words, I suddenly recall.
If I remember correctly—
choice_data_list: There should be a vending machine nearby.
I should have brought some hand warmers.
Like I used to keep a jump rope in my bag or something

text_block_list.text: Looking around, I spotted the faint glow of a vending machine in the distant shade of the trees.
choice_data_list: Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much.
It smells wonderful. It really wakes me up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer-san,
are you not going to have a drink?"
choice_data_list: Actually...

text_block_list.text:
I forgot to buy a drink for myself.
Not wanting to bother walking all the way back to the vending machine, I explained the situation and sat down.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My—well then, I shall go and buy it.
choice_data_list: What!? No, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No, please allow me to buy it.
—Do you happen to know the language of coffee tree flowers?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Let's take a rest together"—is what she meant.

Afterward, warming up with the coffee she bought for me,
we continued waiting for the sunrise—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*...
Ah――I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: Why not take a nap in the car?
Why don't you sleep in the car?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My pocket... is warm.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Still, won't you be cold like this, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: I'm fine, so I want you to use it.
I'll be fine, so I want you to use it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Still—I know.
Would you like to carry it together with me?
choice_data_list: No, no—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It's quite big, after all.
There's definitely enough room to keep both of us warm."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I could also place it on my hand
and let you warm up from above, or—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Or, umm... inside your pocket—"
choice_data_list: I have a spare in the car, so it's fine. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it was?
I-I am so sorry. For making such an absurd proposal—
After that, clutching our hand warmers, the two of us engaged in idle chatter while waiting for the sunrise—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*...
Ah――I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: Why not take a nap in the car?
Why don't you sleep in the car?

text_block_list.text:
It may be a strange suggestion,
but I'm sure it will warm up your body.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Jump rope, is it?
choice_data_list: I bought it yesterday to use for training.
I bought it yesterday thinking I could use it for training.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My—is that so?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That sounds wonderful—it feels like it will warm me to the very core.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It reminds me of when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm—I'm actually pretty good at long-distance jump rope.
I was often the last one standing in my class.
choice_data_list: Impressive, as always.
Impressive, as always.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Thank you very much—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it's almost hot.
Would you like some too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No, no, I'm fine!
No, no, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
It'll warm you right up.

In the end, we did a little jump rope afterward—
and waited for sunrise with our bodies warmed up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*...
Ah――I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: Why not take a nap in the car?
Why don't you sleep in the car?

text_block_list.text:
The parking lot is a short way down the hill.
Inside the car, we'll be shielded from the wind and it'll be a bit warmer.
Yesterday, she was training thoroughly once again to get results in the Tenno Sho (Spring). Fatigue must be catching up with her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—for I might end up
missing the sunrise.
choice_data_list: I'll keep watch from here.
I'll stay here and keep watch

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Please, don't say that... I was the one who invited you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. Please, let me stay here.
choice_data_list: ...I see, understood.
...I see, got it.

text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the dark sky, waiting for the sunrise.
The wait until dawn was far longer than expected.
I had vaguely assumed she suddenly decided to challenge the Tenno Sho (Spring) because she felt uneasy about her path so far. However—
Apparently, that wasn't quite right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Why the Tenno Sho (Spring), you ask?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...It's precisely because it's now that I want to obtain that special flower—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"And I want to dedicate it to you.
Because I truly feel that from the bottom of my heart—
there is nothing more to it than that."
choice_data_list: ...I see.
...I see.

text_block_list.text:
She had told me so many times before
that she wanted to gather victories and present them as a bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
I-I am so sorry. You were asleep, weren't you?
choice_data_list: Why don't you go sleep in the car after all?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Still—

It'll still be a while until sunrise.
I can't let her catch a cold out here.

When I led her down to the parking lot and urged her on,
she finally complied with an apologetic look.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just a little, then.
Thank you very much.

I promised to go call her once the sun came up,
and moved to a spot where I could watch
both the car and the sky.
choice_data_list: (――"I want to dedicate a golden bouquet to you.")

text_block_list.text:
This time as well, she is aiming for the
Tenno Sho (Spring) with that very purpose in mind.
choice_data_list: (...Am I really worthy of that?)
(...Am I really worthy of that?)

text_block_list.text: "Even with plenty of stamina for a Tiara route Umamusume, running in the longest-distance GⅠ race is a whole different ballgame."
"This winter, she had been continuously undergoing extremely high-intensity stamina training."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
――I'm okay. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I just lost my footing for a second, that's all.
I can still do one more rep...!"
—There is someone far more suitable than me.
Even now, those feelings still stubbornly surface and fade from time to time.

To live up to the desire to dedicate the Tenno Sho (Spring)
to them, there is no time to show any weakness.
choice_data_list: (Still, before I became Bouquet's Trainer, I—)
(Still, before I became Bouquet's Trainer, I—)

text_block_list.text:
—I shake my head.
There's no point in dwelling on such things.
choice_data_list: (Just do what needs to be done, no matter what)

text_block_list.text: Switching gears in my mind, I lifted my heavy head, only to see—

Before I knew it, the sky was beginning to lighten.
I hastily turned on my heel and headed for the parking lot.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
...It's a beautiful sky. I'm glad we could watch it together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...May I be able to grasp that special flower
in my hands this spring.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can deliver this
to you, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Wishing for Bouquet to shine in the Tenno Sho (Spring)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu.
"First, to make her dream come true... I need to stay grounded and support her all the way through."
